'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)]]
***Two [[shepherd]]s are killed in the village of [[Wazzani]], [[Lebanon]], after Israeli soldiers opened fire in their direction, while a 16-year-old boy is killed during [[Shell (projectile)|shelling]] by the Israeli Army, bringing the death toll in Lebanon to 66. [https://www.barrons.com/articles/israeli-fire-kills-two-lebanese-shepherds-state-media-ae2dd6e0 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
**[[Evacuations during the Israel–Hamas war]]
***About 500 people, including injured Palestinians, foreigners and dual Palestinian–foreign nationals, are [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]] from the [[Gaza Strip]] through the [[Rafah Border Crossing]] to [[Egypt]], marking the border crossing's first opening since the war began. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/qatar-brokers-deal-between-egypt-hamas-and-israel-for-limited-gaza-evacuations-source (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
**[[Iran–Israel proxy conflict]]
***[[Israel]] deploys [[Sa'ar 6-class corvette|Sa'ar-class corvette]]s to the [[Red Sea]] in response to [[missile]] and [[drone warfare|drone attacks]] from [[Yemen]]. Israeli [[National Security Council (Israel)|National Security Council]] official [[Tzachi Hanegbi]] says that the [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] attacks on Israel are "intolerable". [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-deploys-missile-boats-red-sea-regional-tensions-surge-2023-11-01/ (Reuters)]
***[[Iran]]ian [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Foreign Affairs Minister]] [[Hossein Amir-Abdollahian]] warns of "harsh consequences" if Israel continues its [[2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip|invasion of the Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-warns-harsh-consequences-if-gaza-attacks-continue-2023-11-01/ (Reuters)]
**[[Jabalia refugee camp airstrikes]]
***The [[Jabalia refugee camp]] in the Gaza Strip is hit by Israeli [[airstrike]] for the second consecutive day, with several more people being killed. [https://www.aljazeera.com/gallery/2023/11/1/photos-dozens-killed-in-another-strike-on-jabalia-refugee-camp-in-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
**An [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli soldier]] is killed in a [[mortar (weapon)|mortar]] attack near the [[kibbutz]] of [[Be'eri]] in [[Southern District (Israel)|southern Israel]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-confirms-sgt-first-class-shalev-sharabi-killed-by-mortar-fire-near-gaza/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**The [[Uganda]]n military announces the capture of an [[Allied Democratic Forces]] commander who killed three people, including two tourists, in [[Queen Elizabeth National Park]] on October 27. [https://apnews.com/article/uganda-adf-extremist-rebel-commander-capture-d0c2a8eb1ff2faff48162adb29d84eb5 (AP)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021-present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**The [[Three Brotherhood Alliance]] intensifies its attacks on [[State Administration Council|junta]] outposts in the northern [[Shan State]] as part of [[Operation 1027]]. [https://www.narinjara.com/news/detail/6542698fc006ac9d132f6f92 (Narinjara)]
**The junta regime confirms that [[Myanmar National Democratic Alliance Army]] rebels have seized control of the town of [[Chinshwehaw]] in [[Laukkaing District]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/2/myanmar-rebels-seize-vital-border-town-as-china-calls-for-ceasefire (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[North Korea–Russia relations]]
***[[South Korea]]'s [[National Intelligence Service (South Korea)|National Intelligence Service]] reports that [[North Korea]] has supplied Russia with over one million rounds of artillery [[Shell (projectile)|shells]] for its ongoing [[invasion]] of Ukraine. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/1/north-korea-sends-russia-artillery-rounds-for-satellite-advice-s-korea (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russia]] strikes 118 [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] towns and villages with [[artillery]], missiles, and drones over a 24-hour period, the most in a single day this year. More than 40 attacks are reported in [[Avdiivka]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-67283305 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*Four people are killed and 335 others are infected in [[Zambia]] due to an [[anthrax]] [[Disease outbreak|outbreak]], with the [[Ministry of Health (Zambia)|Ministry of Health]] implementing [[public health]] measures. [https://english.news.cn/20231101/7c1447176a4a47b5a33fe9cac150106c/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israel–Jordan relations]]
***[[Jordan]] recalls its ambassador to [[Israel]] in condemnation of the ongoing war. [https://www.zawya.com/en/world/middle-east/jordan-says-will-recall-ambassador-from-israel-fgwe1tr0 (AFP via Zawya)]
*[[Afghanistan–Pakistan relations]]
**[[Pakistan]] begins the [[deportation|mass deportation]] of undocumented [[Afghan refugees]], according to [[Ministry of Interior (Pakistan)|Interior Minister]] [[Sarfraz Bugti]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2023/nov/01/pakistan-starts-mass-deportation-of-undocumented-afghans (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Operation Dunhammer]]
**The [[Danish Prosecution Service]] discontinues legal proceedings against former [[Minister of Defence (Denmark)|defence minister]] [[Claus Hjort Frederiksen]] and former [[Danish Defence Intelligence Service|intelligence]] chief [[Lars Findsen]] over the [[Data breach|leakage]] of [[classified information]] due to the [[Admissible evidence|inadmissibility]] of key classified evidence in court. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/11/03/world/americas-emea/denmark-gives-up-on-state-secrets-leak-case/1917687 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*The [[European Data Protection Board]] bans American [[social media]] company [[Meta Platforms|Meta]] from acquiring its [[User (computing)|users]]' [[personal data]] for [[targeted advertising]] in the [[European Economic Area]]. [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/eu-regulator-bans-metas-use-of-personal-data-for-behavioural-advertising/articleshow/104894817.cms (AFP via ''The Economic Times'')]
*Police in the [[United Kingdom]], [[Germany]], [[Belgium]], and [[Italy]] arrest several people who threatened or planned terror attacks relating to the ongoing [[Israel–Hamas war]]. [https://www.jpost.com/international/islamic-terrorism/article-771223 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[NASA]] space probe [[Lucy (spacecraft)|Lucy]] flies by [[asteroid]] [[152830 Dinkinesh]], the first of eight asteroids planned to be visited by the spacecraft. [https://apnews.com/article/asteroid-lucy-spacecraft-flyby-8ea721a7ca6710787de7f51afcf8494e (AP)]
'''Sports'''
*[[2023 MLB season]]
**In [[baseball]], the [[Texas Rangers (baseball)|Texas Rangers]] defeat the [[Arizona Diamondbacks]] to win the [[2023 World Series|World Series]] in five games, capturing their first [[Major League Baseball]] championship in their [[History of the Texas Rangers (baseball)|63-year]] existence. [[Corey Seager]] is named [[World Series Most Valuable Player Award|World Series MVP]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna123278 (NBC News)] [https://www.espn.com/mlb/story/_/id/38798075/rangers-corey-seager-wins-second-world-series-mvp-award?platform=amp (ESPN)]
